data_objects.name: monthly_gridded_environmental_timeseries
data_objects.meaning: Six very wide CSV tables of monthly, nominally 1-degree gridded environmental values for 2021 through 2023. Each table is devoted to the quantity named in its filename.

data_objects.name: daily_gridded_temperature_timeseries
data_objects.meaning: A very wide CSV table of daily, nominally 1-degree gridded values labeled as temperature for 2023.

data_objects.name: ten_location_daily_temperature_table
data_objects.meaning: A compact daily 2023 table with a Date column and ten generic series named Location_1 through Location_10; the filename labels the values as temperature.

data_objects.name: grid_cell_metadata_workbook
data_objects.meaning: A one-sheet workbook of coordinate-keyed grid-cell metadata. Inspected columns include latitude and longitude ranges, country, mean elevation, land-cover attributes, and named climate-category attributes.

data_objects.name: coordinate_relief_images
data_objects.meaning: A collection of PNG images labeled as relief and keyed by latitude/longitude-like identifiers in their filenames.

structure.description: Every inspected dense gridded CSV has 64,801 columns: Date followed by 64,800 coordinate-coded value columns. Dates occupy rows and spatial cells occupy columns; the filenames identify monthly versus daily cadence and the measured quantity.
The six monthly tables share the same observed header pattern and nominal 2021-to-2023 period. The daily dense table uses the same observed spatial-column pattern and a nominal 2023 period.
The compact daily table is date-indexed with ten generic Location_n value columns. No inspected field maps those labels to the coordinate-coded columns of the dense grid.

The workbook contains one worksheet with dimension A1:BP61201, corresponding to 68 columns and 61,200 data rows plus a header. Its ID field and the dense CSV headers use a similar compact latitude/longitude naming convention, providing an apparent grid-cell key.

The 57,300 relief PNG filenames use the same general latitude/longitude token pattern as workbook IDs and gridded CSV columns. The image directory is therefore apparently coordinate-addressed, although coverage is not one-to-one across objects.

uncertainties: No units were present in the inspected CSV headers, filenames, or first 40 workbook columns. Units for all measurements, Mean elevation, land-cover fields, and climate-category fields are therefore left null.
The abbreviations lwd, swd, and pres are not expanded by the inspected public artifacts, so their precise physical quantities are not asserted.
The workbook has 68 columns, but inspection was intentionally limited to the first 40 columns (A through AN). The semantics of columns AO through BP remain unknown.

The land-cover and climate-category fields are numeric and sampled land-cover values include numbers between zero and one, but the workbook does not state whether these are fractions, proportions, indicators, or another encoding.

The dense time-series tables have 64,800 spatial columns, the workbook has 61,200 data rows, and the image directory has 57,300 files. These differing counts show that complete one-to-one coverage cannot be assumed.

The exact anchor represented by coordinate tokens such as 90S_180W or 84S_180W (for example cell edge, corner, or nominal label) is not explicitly defined. The workbook's sampled latitude and longitude ranges provide bounds only for its own sampled IDs.
The ten generic Location_n columns in the compact daily table have no inspected coordinate, country, or workbook-ID mapping.
Only headers and two representative data rows were sampled from selected CSVs; full date extents, missing-value conventions, value ranges, and row completeness were not verified.
Only PNG metadata was inspected for three representative images. Their relief scale, color encoding, geographic footprint, orientation, and pixel interpretation are unknown.
The three sampled PNGs were 8-bit RGB and non-interlaced with a common width of 1418 pixels but varying heights (1408, 1621, and 7782 pixels); uniform image dimensions should not be assumed.
annotation_notes: Inspection was restricted to descendants of the prepared/public directory and used no task, private, gold, grader, output, description, prior annotation, experiment-skill, or network material.
Inventory found two top-level directories, one nested image directory, seven dense CSVs under timeseries, one compact root CSV, one root XLSX workbook, and 57,300 PNG files under images/img_relief.

All seven dense CSV headers were checked only far enough to establish a 64,801-column layout and inspect the first 40 header labels; at most two data rows were sampled from representative monthly and daily files.
Workbook inspection used its XLSX metadata plus the first three rows and first 40 columns of its sole worksheet; the declared worksheet dimension was A1:BP61201.
Image inspection was limited to file metadata for relief_30N_157W.png, relief_0S_156W.png, and relief_79S_70W.png.
